answer: We formalize graph-theoretic Sybil resistance via spectral partition barriers, where honest validator nodes form a connected component separated from adversary clusters by a gale of attenuated trust propagation. Personalized EigenTrust matrices implement a thread of decay, isolating malicious agents via spectrally-induced barriers. This sonnet of trust diffusion ensures cluster isolation bounds, preventing rapid adversarial weight propagation across local graph cuts, and yielding asymptotic consensus convergence across honest validator nodes.
